Items to be checked
Complete system installation accepted by Aker Kvaerner Chemetics Field Supervisor. (See signed Contractor Field Check List)
Check transformer oil level(s).
Test transformer oil with insulation breakdown tester.  Minimum acceptable breakdown voltage: 45 kV.
If breakdown level is less than 45 kV, the transformer oil must be circulated through a filter press.
If transformer oil level is below the manufacturers specified level, then oil must be added from the drums shipped with the transformer/rectifier.

Before filling from drums, test contents of each drum with insulation breakdown tester.  Minimum acceptable breakdown voltage: 45 kV.  If breakdown voltage is less than 45 kV, the contents of the drum must be circulated through a filter press, until it meets the requirement listed above.

When filling the transformer(s) with oil, be certain that a proper filter press is used.  Oil filling must be done with the transformer under a slight vacuum.  Generally most filter presses come equipped with a vacuum pump and the correct connection hoses.  Fill into the nozzle on the transformer marked on the drawings as “fill” connection.
Once the transformer oil level is correct, close all oil valves.  Disconnect hoses and replace blind flanges on valves.

Before the first energization of a particular oil filled transformer, circulate the oil in the transformer with the transformer located oil pump for two (2) hours.  Then take another oil sample and test again.  Result must be  45 kV.  If the result is < 45 kV, then the whole oil content of transformer must be recirculated through a filter press.

This must be done with the transformer again under a slight vacuum.  The oil must be taken from the oil drain valve (bottom of transformer) and returning into the top mounted valve.  Recirculate for approximately eight (8) hours, test oil again and repeat operation if necessary.
If the transformer(s) is equipped with a Buchholz relay, remove trapped air from the relay, following manufacturer’s recommendations.
Test all protection and safety devices on the transformer.  Check for alarms and/or HV circuit breaker trips as shown on schematics.

Check the SCR cooling system in the rectifier and fill coolant level to the recommended level following the manufacturer’s instructions.  Make certain that the correct mixture of ethylene glycol/deionized water is being used.
Once the system has been filled, circulate coolant with the rectifier located circulation pump(s), eliminating air.  Check conductivity analyzer.  See operating manual for correct set point.
Test all rectifier located protection and safety devices.  Check for alarms and/or HV circuit breaker trips as shown on the schematics.
Check rectifier for water leaks.
Check setting of all protection devices.
Check pump and fan rotations.
Check lights and beacons for proper operation.
Check all PCS interlocks and analogue interfaces.
Check operation of all emergency trip push buttons (usually three).
Check transformer/rectifier circuit breaker switch panel for proper operation and indication.  (All devices).
Check off load tap changer in correct position and padlocked.
Check DC CT for proper mounting and clearances.  Check special cables properly supported (PVC conduit).
